title: AI service is restarted after a finished print to give its memory back (optional)
note: OPTIONAL. Install with: --with algo-app-recycle. After a print has been over for 2 minutes (finished, cancelled or failed; Moonraker print_stats), the AI service algo_app is restarted if it is bigger than 130 MB, which gives back ~40-100 MB before timelapse rendering and for the next print without AI. It never starts a stopped service, never restarts while a print runs or is paused (checked again right before), and skips a service that is already small. The AI setting stays (it is stored in Klipper); the model is loaded again at layer 2 of the next print. Needs ~1 MB (a shell loop that asks Moonraker every 10 s). Evidence: stopping/restarting algo_app on 22.11 freed ~40 MB (restart) and ~190 MB (stop) during a print; whether the effect lasts over many prints is not measured. Uninstall removes the service and the files.
